advection1d_domain: Grid: u0_batch[:, i] is the value at x_i = x_min + i*(x_max - x_min)/N for i = 0, ..., N-1. The grid is periodic with spacing (x_max - x_min)/N, so x = x_max is the same point as x = x_min.
airy1d: Grid: u0_batch[:, i] is the value at x_i = i*L/N for i = 0, ..., N-1. The grid is periodic with spacing L/N, so x = L is the same point as x = 0.
hyperdiffusion1d: Grid: u0_batch[:, i] is the value at x_i = i*L/N for i = 0, ..., N-1. The grid is periodic with spacing L/N, so x = L is the same point as x = 0.
